# RedisQueue.drain() method

Stops reading and hands on every message the reader already took from the broker, before a teardown that would drop the reader at once.

**Signature:**

```typescript
drain(timeoutMs?: number): Promise<void>;
```

**Returns:**

Promise&lt;void&gt;

## Remarks

The reader is released from its blocking read by `CLIENT UNBLOCK` sent on the writer. A message the broker already handed it is still in the socket, ahead of the release, so it reaches the `message` listeners before the loop stops; nothing further is taken. Without this, a reply popped but not yet read was lost with the socket, and its caller waited out its whole timeout. Never rejects; a host that does not answer is given up on after `timeoutMs`<!-- -->.
